---
title: Wrapping Up
---

## Downloading Survey and Responses

Before deleting your project, it is important to create backups of both the survey and the response data. 

### Step 1: Export the Survey as a QSF File and Txt File

You can find extensive guidance on the [user move page](https://www.qualtrics.com/support/survey-platform/managing-your-account/user-moves/)

1. Open the survey project.

2. Export the survey in QSF (Qualtrics Survey Format). A QSF format is usefull if you wish to re-import the data into Qualtrics again.

3. Save the QSF file in a secure location.

4. Export the survey as well in an advanced txt word or a simple txt word. The advanced format makes it easier to re-import your survery into qualtrics, while the simple format is more human friendly to read. You can find more information on the exporting surveys on [Qualtrics importing & exportinig surveys page](https://www.qualtrics.com/support/survey-platform/survey-module/survey-tools/import-and-export-surveys/#ExportingaSurveyasaQSF)


### Step 3: Export Response Data as CSV

You can find extensive guidance on the [user move page](https://www.qualtrics.com/support/survey-platform/managing-your-account/user-moves/)

1. Go to Data & Analysis.

2. Export the responses as a CSV file.

3. Store the file securely.

Once responses are deleted, they cannot be recovered. The CSV file preserves all collected data for future analysis.
